claim_boundary: Posthoc method iteration after earlier NVOS target results were opened. The gate is source-only and may support a method-design claim, but this sentinel is not an independent validation set.
failure_being_addressed: Entropy of the ten-mask mean measures pixelwise SAM3 self-agreement but does not detect an individual completion trial that collapses or loses the object. Such a failure can still produce high aggregate confidence and override a stronger compact field.

source_only_gate.name: all_trial_loo_majority_iou_v1
source_only_gate.input: the ten immutable official SAM3 binary source-view trial masks before scribble overwrite
source_only_gate.for_each_trial: hold out trial t; form a binary strict source consensus as mean(other nine)>=0.5; compute Jaccard IoU between heldout trial and that consensus
source_only_gate.accept: all ten heldout IoUs are at least 0.5
source_only_gate.threshold_authority: 0.5 is used both as the Bernoulli majority decision and as the minimum majority-overlap criterion; it is fixed globally and is not fit to a scene or target result
source_only_gate.empty_policy: an empty heldout mask, empty leave-one-out consensus, or empty union fails closed

deployment.accept: retain the frozen probability-preserving source completion reliability
deployment.reject: set only source-completion reliability to exact zero; preserve the raw signed-scribble compiler and compact field unary; zero-confidence fusion must return the field unary bit-for-bit

authority_requirements.gate_receipt: immutable no-clobber JSON created before target rendering
authority_requirements.evaluator: must recompute the source-only decision from the bound completion artifact and fail closed on any mismatch

frozen_sentinel.base: compact canonical field, graph off, raw signed-scribble K16 unary, threshold 0.5
frozen_sentinel.candidate: the previously frozen probability-preserving source unary with the new immutable source-only abstention receipt

promotion_gate.pass: candidate macro exceeds the compact base by at least 0.005, at least one scene improves, and neither scene regresses by more than 0.02
promotion_gate.failure: retain only the source-only diagnostic and do not expand to the remaining NVOS cohort
promotion_gate.success: expand the exact same gate and compiler without scene-specific changes

thermal_policy.poll: launch and stage boundary only unless a run becomes abnormal
